notes: The predicate copula are is placed on the lexical noun footmen; attaching it to the leading numeral remains defensible and is named in the unit note.
ḥōdeš yāmîm is read attributively as a whole month, as in v.20 (rule 28).
bə-qereb is fused as among and carries the relative clause's copula, the resumptive suffix going unrepresented.
